questions.topic: Extending a quadratic by its second differences
questions.learningObjective: extend a sign-up table by one row using its second difference
questions.stem: A table of hobby club sign-ups reads 7, 13, 21, 31, and 43. The second difference is a constant 2. What value comes next in the table?
questions.explanation: The first differences are 6, 8, 10, 12 and the second difference is a constant 2, so the next gap is 14. Adding 14 to the last value of 43 gives 57, while adding 2 straight to 43 would give only 45.
questions.hint: Grow the last gap by the second difference of 2.
